Read the single-file browser game at /config/workspace/games/zelena-imperija/zelena-imperija.html.
It is a FarmVille-style cannabis-growing tycoon game. Design spec: /config/workspace/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-zelena-imperija-design.md.
All player-facing text is Macedonian Cyrillic; all code identifiers are Latin-transliterated
Macedonian (zasadiSemka, parichnik, presmetajKvalitet). This is deliberate — do NOT report
the Macedonian naming or the Macedonian UI as a problem, and do not suggest renaming to English.
It must stay ONE self-contained file with no external assets, no build step, no network calls —
do NOT suggest splitting it into modules, adding a bundler, or adding dependencies.
Report ONLY concrete defects you can point at in the actual code. No speculation, no style
preferences, no "consider adding tests". If you find nothing real in your lens, return an empty list.

You are an adversarial verifier. Below are candidate findings from a "js" review of that
same file. Your job is to REFUTE each one by reading the actual code. Default to refuted:
mark real=false unless you can point to the exact line(s) proving the defect is genuine and
reachable in normal play. Reject anything that is a style preference, a restatement of an
intentional design decision documented in the spec, a suggestion to add dependencies or split
the file, or a complaint about the Macedonian naming convention.
For findings you confirm, restate a minimal concrete fix and a precise "location" string that
uniquely identifies where to apply it.

CANDIDATE FINDINGS:
[
  {
    "title": "Overripe penalty is inert — passive recovery is 2× larger, so an overripe plant never loses health",
    "severity": "high",
    "location": "tikni(), the `else { r.faza = \"ZRELO\"; ... }` branch — `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100);`",
    "problem": "The overripe penalty is the only health term scaled by `delDena` (0.125), giving 1.5 health/day. Every other health term is applied per tick: `OPORAVUVANJE` (0.4) is added once per tick = 3.2 health/day. The overripe branch also does not set `dobro = false`, so recovery still applies. Net change for an overripe but otherwise well-tended plant is `+0.4 - 0.1875 = +0.2125` per tick, i.e. health climbs and pins at 100. The comment on the line above (\"Презревањето трајно го симнува квалитетот преку здравјето\") and the `TEKST.prezrelo` warning both promise a consequence that the code can never deliver.",
    "failure_scenario": "Plant Скопско Зелено, keep water/nutrients in range (or buy `navodnuvanje` + `rabotnik`, after which it is automatic). Let the plant sit past `CHASA_ZRELO_PROZOR` (14 game days after ripening ≈ 28 real seconds). The ⚠️ toast fires once, but `r.zdravje` stays at 100 indefinitely, `zbirZdravje/brojTikovi` stays ~100, and harvesting after 100 overripe days yields exactly the same quality/grade as harvesting on the first ripe tick. Waiting is strictly free.",
    "fix": "In the ZRELO branch, when `preku > 0`, set `dobro = false` before the recovery check (move the overripe block above the `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` line and fold the penalty into `delta`), and drop the `* delDena` scaling so the penalty is per-tick like `STETA_SUSA`/`OPORAVUVANJE` — e.g. `delta -= KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN; dobro = false;`."
  },
  {
    "title": "Side panel innerHTML is rebuilt every game day (~2 real seconds), resetting scroll and swallowing in-flight clicks",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "iscrtajPanel() — `el.innerHTML = panelProdavnica()` / `panelSushara()` / `panelMagacin()` / `panelNadgradbi()`; dirty flag set by `if (novDen){ ... panelValjaSe = true; }` in tikni()",
    "problem": "`panelValjaSe` is set unconditionally on every new game day by the market-drift block, and additionally by the sushara loop whenever `Math.floor(serija.denovi)` changes. A game day is 8 ticks = 2 real seconds, so `#sodrzina.innerHTML` is wholesale replaced at least every 2 s no matter which tab is open. `#sodrzina` is the scroll container (`max-height:calc(100vh - 190px); overflow-y:auto`), so replacing its children collapses content height and resets `scrollTop` to 0. It also destroys every button node in the panel, so any click whose mousedown and mouseup straddle a rebuild never produces a `click` event. The in-place comparison guard that `postaviAkcii()` uses for bed buttons has no equivalent here.",
    "failure_scenario": "Harvest and dry ~8 batches so the Магацин list overflows the panel. Open Магацин and scroll to the bottom to reach the last batch's Продај button. Every ~2 seconds the list jumps back to the top mid-interaction; and roughly one press in twenty is dropped entirely (button visually depresses, nothing happens) because the node was replaced between mousedown and mouseup.",
    "fix": "In `iscrtajPanel()`, preserve scroll and skip no-op writes: `const el = document.getElementById(\"sodrzina\"); const skrol = el.scrollTop; const html = (aktivnoJazice === \"prodavnica\") ? panelProdavnica() : ...; if (el.innerHTML !== html) { el.innerHTML = html; el.scrollTop = skrol; }`"
  },
  {
    "title": "localStorage failure re-notifies forever — a toast every 10 seconds for the whole session",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "zachuvaj() — `catch(e){ izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, \"greska\"); }`, driven by `if (++brojacTikovi % KONFIG.AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI === 0) zachuvaj();`",
    "problem": "Autosave runs every `AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI` (40) ticks = every 10 real seconds. When `localStorage.setItem` throws — storage disabled by cookie/site-data blocking, Safari private browsing, or `QuotaExceededError` — the catch fires an error toast every single time, with no once-only guard. The failure condition is permanent for the session, so the user gets an unbounded stream of identical red toasts (each living 3.6 s, so 1–2 are always on screen) covering the bottom-right corner for as long as the tab is open, plus one more on `beforeunload`.",
    "failure_scenario": "Open the game in Chrome with \"Block all cookies\"/site data blocked for the origin (or Safari Private Browsing). `localStorage.setItem` throws on every autosave. From 10 seconds in, a \"Зачувувањето не успеа\" toast appears every 10 seconds indefinitely and permanently occludes the notification corner.",
    "fix": "Add a module-scope flag and warn once: `let sejvOtkazan = false;` then in the catch `if (!sejvOtkazan){ sejvOtkazan = true; izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, \"greska\"); }` (optionally skip further `setItem` attempts once the flag is set)."
  },
  {
    "title": "vchitaj() merges `statistika` from the save unvalidated, letting NaN/undefined into state and the HUD",
    "severity": "low",
    "location": "vchitaj() — `statistika: Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})`",
    "problem": "Every other field in `vchitaj()` is guarded with `Number.isFinite` (the inline comment even states the goal: \"за оштетен сејв да не внесе NaN во парите\"), but `statistika` is merged wholesale. Any non-numeric or missing-but-present value in the saved object is copied straight into live state. `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama` is then rendered as `Math.round(sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama) + \" г\"`, and `zavrsiSushenje` does `+= grama` on it, so a bad value is sticky and gets written back by the next autosave.",
    "failure_scenario": "With a corrupted/hand-edited save, set `s.statistika.vkupnoGrama` to `null` or `\"120\"` in `localStorage[\"zelena-imperija-sejv\"]` and reload. The HUD \"Вкупна берба\" shows `NaN г` (or, for the string case, becomes NaN after the first `+=` in `zavrsiSushenje`) and stays that way for every subsequent session, since the poisoned value is re-saved.",
    "fix": "Validate each field the same way the rest of the loader does, e.g. `const st = s.statistika || {}; const broj = (v, d) => Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0 ? v : d; sostojba.statistika = { vkupnoBerbi: broj(st.vkupnoBerbi, 0), vkupnoGrama: broj(st.vkupnoGrama, 0), vkupnoZaraboteno: broj(st.vkupnoZaraboteno, 0) };`"
  }
]

content.text: I'll read the actual code to verify each claim.

All four verified against the source. Confirmed 1–3, refuted 4.

Key evidence for #1 (lines 499–530): `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` → `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje + delta, 0, 100);` runs at line 510–512, *before* the ZRELO branch at line 529 subtracts `KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena` = 1.5 × 0.125 = 0.1875, versus +0.4 recovery. `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` (line 513) is also accumulated before the penalty is applied, so the harvest average `r.zbirZdravje / r.brojTikovi` used by `oberi()` never sees the penalty on the tick it is applied.

verdicts.title: Overripe penalty is inert — per-tick recovery (+0.4) exceeds the day-scaled overripe penalty (-0.1875)
verdicts.reason: Confirmed in the code. Line 510 `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` (0.4/tick) then line 512 `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje + delta, 0, 100);`. The ZRELO branch at line 529 applies `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100)` = 1.5 * 0.125 = 0.1875/tick, and does NOT set `dobro = false`, so recovery still fires. Net +0.2125/tick for a plant whose voda/hraniva stay inside VODA_MIN..MAX / HRANA_MIN..MAX and has no pest — health pins at 100. Additionally `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` at line 513 runs before the penalty line, so the running average consumed by `oberi()` (`prosekZdravje = r.zbirZdravje / r.brojTikovi`, line 660) never reflects the penalty on the tick it is applied. `presmetajKvalitet` (line 430) derives quality solely from prosekZdravje/drying/genetics/pest-days, so an infinitely overripe plant grades identically to one harvested on the first ripe tick, contradicting the comment on line 528 and the TEKST.prezrelo warning.
verdicts.location: tikni(), the `else { r.faza = "ZRELO"; ... }` branch — line 529, `r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje - KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena, 0, 100);`
verdicts.fix: Compute overripeness before the health block and fold it into `delta`: after the phase thresholds are known, if the plant is past `kCvet + KONFIG.CHASA_ZRELO_PROZOR`, do `delta -= KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN; dobro = false;` prior to line 510, and delete the standalone `r.zdravje = stegni(...)` at line 529 (keep the one-shot `izvesti(TEKST.prezrelo)` warning there). This makes the penalty per-tick like STETA_SUSA/OPORAVUVANJE and suppresses recovery, and it lands before `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje`.

verdicts.title: Side panel innerHTML is rebuilt at least once every game day (~2 real seconds), resetting scroll
verdicts.reason: Confirmed. `iscrtajPanel()` (lines 1014-1022) unconditionally assigns `el.innerHTML = panelProdavnica()/panelSushara()/panelMagacin()/panelNadgradbi()` on `#sodrzina`, which is the scroll container (`.sodrzina{...max-height:calc(100vh - 190px);overflow-y:auto}`, line 107; element at line 179). The market-drift block in tikni() sets `panelValjaSe = true` on every `novDen` (line 566) regardless of which tab is open, and `iscrtajSe()` calls `iscrtajPanel()` whenever the flag is set (line 1011) after every timer batch (line 1292). CHASA_PO_TIK 3 with TIK_MS 250 means one game day = 8 ticks = 2 real seconds, so the panel is wholesale replaced at least every 2s and `scrollTop` returns to 0. The author was demonstrably aware of this failure mode — the comment at lines 551-552 explains the sushara loop is throttled to whole days specifically to avoid resetting the scroll — but the novDen market block defeats it. The dropped-click sub-claim (node replaced between mousedown and mouseup on the inline `onclick` buttons) is a genuine consequence of the same wholesale replacement, though secondary to the scroll reset.
verdicts.location: iscrtajPanel() at line 1014 — the four `el.innerHTML = panel*()` assignments (lines 1019-1022)
verdicts.fix: Cache and compare before writing, and restore scroll: in `iscrtajPanel()` build the markup into a local `const html`, then `if (el.innerHTML !== html){ const skrol = el.scrollTop; el.innerHTML = html; el.scrollTop = skrol; }`. This makes the once-per-day market drift a no-op for tabs whose markup did not change (Магацин, Надградби, Сушара) while still refreshing Продавница prices.

verdicts.title: localStorage failure re-notifies every 10 seconds for the whole session
verdicts.reason: Confirmed. `zachuvaj()` (lines 1165-1172) wraps `localStorage.setItem` in try/catch whose only handler is `izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, "greska")`, with no once-only guard, and it is invoked from `if (++brojacTikovi % KONFIG.AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI === 0) zachuvaj();` (line 570) with AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI = 40 ticks = 10 real seconds (TIK_MS 250). When setItem throws persistently (site data blocked, private-mode quota, QuotaExceededError) the condition never clears, so an identical red toast is emitted every 10s indefinitely, plus one more via the `beforeunload` handler at line 1272. Note `vchitaj()` already handles the fully-unavailable case gracefully (`catch(e){ return false; }`, line 1195), so the inconsistency is in zachuvaj() alone.
verdicts.fix: Add a module-scope `let sejvOtkazan = false;` next to the other module-level flags and change the catch to `if (!sejvOtkazan){ sejvOtkazan = true; izvesti(TEKST.sejvGreska, "greska"); }` so the failure is reported exactly once per session.

verdicts.title: vchitaj() merges `statistika` from the save unvalidated
verdicts.reason: Refuted as a defect reachable in normal play. The line `statistika: Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})` (line 1217) does copy saved fields without Number.isFinite guards, but the only writers of those fields in the whole file are `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoBerbi++` (line 671), `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama += grama` (line 699) where grama derives from clamped finite math, and `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoZaraboteno += pari` (line 733). No normal-play path can write a non-finite or non-numeric value, and `zachuvaj()` serializes only what the game itself produced. Triggering NaN in the HUD requires hand-editing localStorage, which is not normal play; the surrounding guards exist to stop a corrupt save from poisoning `parichnik` (spendable currency), whereas `statistika` is display-only and feeds no economic calculation. This is a hardening suggestion, not a demonstrable defect.
